workflowContracts.notes: Laboratory Next measurements, not proof of deployed Worker CPU/performance or live advertising.

workflowContracts.behavior: Select Pages(default) or Workers, verify target deployment, then external zone-cache purge
workflowContracts.notes: This workflow is intentionally a post-deployment mutation, not local QA and not a publishing job. No run was dispatched here.

workersPurge.selection: inputs.target || vars.CF_DEPLOY_TARGET || pages; worker_name input || vars.CF_WORKER_NAME
workersPurge.automaticIdentity: CF_RELEASE_TAG defaults to GitHub SHA, which must exactly match the upload annotation workers/tag
workersPurge.manualIdentity: workflow_dispatch Workers runs require full expected_version_id; release_tag must match that version
checks: Named Worker deployments[0] has percentage strategy and one version at exactly 100%
Version metadata ID matches candidate and workers/tag equals exact release tag
Read deployments again after version lookup to reject changed activation
After settle, pin exact version and original deployment ID; reverify before every purge retry
Incomplete Workers configuration fails closed; missing Pages credentials can still yield a successful skip
limits: Control-plane identity is not proof that production hostname routes point to that Worker
Does not validate app health, D1 data reception, cache key behavior or artifact/source equivalence beyond the release tag contract
No API can lock deployment against a change immediately after the final read
Pages rollback mode recognizes a successful matching commit; it does not restore routing or prove that commit is currently selected

findings.detail: Contact/feedback docs claimed a draft Worker with no routes/D1; updated to prepared production declarations, separate QA config and unverified remote installation.
Pages-only Purge/IndexNow explanations replaced with current Workers target/tag/version verification, capture-before-cutover and submit-after-activation/route/purge contract.

Main push and old Pages/brief publisher instructions could imply automatic Workers publication. Docs now require disabling Pages auto-deploy and source publishers before merge/push; resolving queued Pages builds; preserving rollback; verifying a functioning Workers publication path before publishers resume.
adsense-test-traffic.md previously allowed local or preview inspection; updated to AGENTS loopback-only browser rule and guarded wrappers.
Boilerplate Vercel deployment and localhost:3000 instructions replaced with current loopback ports, QA/production distinction, prepared-not-deployed state and runbook links.
Missing deployment-transition.json links in current operational docs replaced by current audit; older draft inventories are identified as historical rather than current receipts.

No Workers publishing job exists among the three workflows. Existing external Pages Git integration and queued deployments cannot be inferred from local files. Disable/verify those before migration push; configure an authorized manual or automatic Workers publishing path.

ci.yml Pages-independent-build comment and cf-purge header comments about all missing credentials skipping are historical. Actual Workers code fails on missing settings and checks activation. These comments were not changed because this review was limited to docs.

rollbackRequirements: Retain known-good Pages deployment/commit, project, DNS/custom domains, and pre-cutover Worker route mapping
First-cutover rollback restores/removes only changed Worker routes after confirming retained Pages origin; do not delete Pages or drop/recreate D1
After actual Pages routing restoration, dispatch target=pages with intended release_sha and verify purge rather than treating successful skip as completion
Later Worker rollback uses a known-good immutable version at 100%, exact tag/version verification and Workers-mode purge
Retain IndexNow manifest+receipt; do not re-submit an ambiguous attempt or reuse it for another release
remainingReleaseActions: Authenticate and verify intended account permissions without exposing credentials
Disable existing Pages production auto-deploy and resolve queued builds before main merge/push
Confirm source publishers disabled and establish working Workers publication contract before resuming them
Verify repository Workers purge variables/secret scopes and exact SHA/tag or manual-version contract
Build fresh ordinary-visitor artifact from approved source, preserve current guarded worker-entry wrapper, populate cache/assets and pass artifact integrity/budget checks
Verify Worker plan/CPU budget, existing D1 binding/schema/secret and public hostname routing independently
Activate intended immutable version, verify route/application state, purge, then submit captured IndexNow delta once
Update release status in docs only after actual activation evidence exists
